bio: Situated in 250 acres of stunning Berkshire countryside, De Vere Wokefield Estate is the perfect setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea with loved ones.  The restaurant, 1560, is located in the grand Grade II listed Mansion House with direct access to an outdoor terrace area overlooking the lawns and lakes of the Estate open in the warmer months.  The Afternoon Tea menu features a savoury starter, followed by a selection of sandwiches with traditional fillings, warm scones with clotted cream & jam, with a variety of seasonal cakes to finish.  Choose from a selection of Twinings teas and infusions, including English Breakfast, Earl Grey and Cranberry & Raspberry.  De Vere Wokefield Estate is located near Reading, just 10 minutes from J11 of the M4 with 350 complimentary parking spaces onsite.  Please specify 'Afternoon Tea' in the Specific Requests box on the booking form.
